Headed to ASHG? Check out KPN Events throughout the week.

Will you be attending ASHG 2025 in Boston? The Knowledge Portal Network team will be attending and we have a variety of events that we hope to see you at. View our program of events here.

Headed to ASBMR? Visit MSK-KP at Booth 124!

Join us September 5-7th at ASBMR 2025!

Interested in helping us mature the Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal (MSKKP.org)?

Interested in helping us mature the Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal (MSKKP.org)? Join us next Thursday as we walk through future plans including new single cell data, tissues, and more! We will showcase future plans, give a demonstration of the current portal, and introduce new single cell data to be ingested.
